summary: Polar Power, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 28, 2026, reporting entry into two convertible notes totaling $165,000 principal for $150,000 proceeds, with 1% monthly interest and maturity on November 26, 2026. If unpaid, notes convert to common stock at 80% of VWAP or $1.00 per share, whichever is lower. Proceeds from a Roth Principal Investments purchase agreement will repay notes. The board also expanded to six directors, electing Lewis Wilks. This is routine financing and a standard board appointment, not a special situation.
